caption: The drawing features three objects presented on a plain, beige background. The top object is a long, dark metal tool resembling a two-pronged fork with a handle that ends in a looped, ornate design. The middle object, encased within a rectangular border with notched corners, is a monochromatic side view sketch of the pronged tool above, showing the prongs curving downward. The bottom object is a large, dark metallic spoon with a deep, circular bowl and a long handle. The handle of the spoon features engraved text and terminates in a pointed end with a hole near the tip. The colors used in the drawing are predominantly shades of brown and black, giving the objects an aged, metallic appearance. The background remains unembellished, and a signature reading "Rex Bush" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Fork and Ladle
